title: Signal
description: Standardized output emitted by any sensor in the harness. Cross-sensor uniformity lets the harness route, retry, and chain feedback regardless of the sensor's underlying execution type (computational or inferential). Reference: Boeckeler, 'Harness Engineering' (martinfowler.com); Lopopolo, 'Harness engineering: leveraging Codex…' (openai.com, 2026-02-11).

Verdict.description: pass = no issue observed; warn = advisory, non-blocking; fail = the observation found a problem in the system under test; error = the sensor itself could not run (timeout, crash, malformed output). 'fail' and 'error' MUST not be conflated.

Severity.description: Impact level of the observation. info is the default for verdict=pass.

sensor_id.description: Stable id of the sensor that produced this signal. MUST equal the id field in the sensor's definition (sensor.json).

version.description: SemVer of the sensor at the moment of execution.

run_id.description: Unique identifier of this invocation; runners may use a `<pid>-<short-uuid8>` composite or a plain UUID/ULID.

score.description: Optional graded value for sensors that emit a continuous signal (e.g. similarity, risk, anomaly score).

confidence.description: MUST be 1.0 for computational sensors. Calibrated against a labelled fixture set for inferential sensors.

evidence.description: Concrete observations supporting the verdict. Empty array allowed for verdict=pass.

remediation.description: LLM-consumable self-correction guidance. The instructions field is the highest-leverage one — write it as imperative prompt-injection for the next agent turn. Optional for verdict=pass; strongly encouraged for warn/fail.

instructions.description: Imperative, agent-addressed text. Tell the agent exactly what to change and why.

items.description: Doc paths or URLs supporting the remediation.

metadata.description: Sensor-specific free-form data. Not interpreted by the harness.
